status: read-only posterior actuator candidate screen; anchors are proposed and not built

methods.operating: All52 native pivot world matrices from the captured21-pose packet replayed on attempt-14 after exact pivot-name-set equality was checked against attempt-07. Proposed posterior endpoints only; no panel transforms added beyond each captured pose. The straight segment is sampled at17 equally spaced points for each target owner group, with a BVH ray test for centerline surface piercing.
methods.openSweep: 101 open values 0..1 at separation0; captured runtime-rest pivot transforms applied first, then only breastplate rotation is changed by production formula rotation.y=-1.35*open. Other native owners remain at rest. Breastplate assembly is all native mesh descendants of breastplate.
methods.clearance: For each target group, min of17 point-to-evaluated-surface distances; conservative segment lower bound subtracts half the point spacing. A12mm envelope radius is subtracted separately. No actuator solid/fittings are present.
methods.upperPitch: With captured runtime-rest hierarchy, sample absolute cervical-upper local X pitch from -0.091 to +0.4225 rad at101 points; measure center-to-center link length and signed torque arm of unit link force about the upper pivot local-X axis. This is a kinematic line calculation only.
methods.coordinates: Packet pivot matrices are converted using the production Blender/runtime basis matrix; owner-local proposed mount coordinates are transformed by the actual owner pivots. Breast open sweep uses converted parent-local panel delta around actual native body parent.
